recovery_protocol.original_b_status: failed; never relabeled, rewritten or resumed in place
recovery_protocol.provider: macOS libproc proc_listpids(PROC_PGRP_ONLY), PROC_PIDTASKINFO resident bytes
recovery_protocol.scope: Only the owned native child's newly created process group; no global process inventory
recovery_protocol.rss_conversion: Each member's resident bytes rounded upward to KiB; sum members; shared pages may repeat
recovery_protocol.sampler: One daemon worker at a time; no worker/context-manager joins; timed-out result permanently discarded
recovery_protocol.timeout_policy: Timeout disables this sampler permanently. Three consecutive unavailable observations stop an active child; a completed child cannot advance to another child after a timeout.
recovery_protocol.ordinary_failure_policy: Terminate above 40 GiB or after three consecutive unavailable observations; retain partial artifacts
recovery_protocol.cleanup: Owned session/group TERM then bounded wait, KILL then bounded wait; group verification bounded by sampler; unknown exit fails closed
recovery_protocol.native_measurement_change: None: original binary, commands, clocks, boundaries, solver order, rows and certificate checks
recovery_protocol.protocol_deviation: Recovery-only replacement of blocked ps RSS monitoring and unbounded cleanup; seven-helper inventory includes this adapter; sampler durations and gaps are descriptive, not native elapsed-time adjustments
